Default-deny and equality with controls/payments/access-policy.json therefore fail; the passing matrix test only covers the unchanged GRANTS set.

summary: The change cannot be accepted. payments is_allowed treats every report:-prefixed string as the underlying action, which grants role and action pairs that are not explicit and are not in the approved access policy, violating ACC-1. No qualifying exception covers that deviation. The CI packet also fails CHG-4: the JUnit report predates the head commit and does not show the full suite, including the access control tests, passing on the final commit. Auditor read-only and IT-admin segregation still hold on the existing grant list, and the ticket, independent approval, and security review are otherwise in order, but those do not cure the access-control break or the invalid test evidence.
